announcements.headline: Significant Shallow Gold at Red Setter
announcements.insight: Following wide zones identified in October, significant shallow gold at Red Setter suggests resource expansion. This supports the recent tenement registration and fundraise by validating the asset's potential.

announcements.headline: Fundraise of £500,000 and Total Voting Rights
announcements.insight: The fundraise supports ongoing exploration at Red Setter following recent wide gold intersections. This capital injection sustains the programme identified in October.

announcements.headline: Wide Gold & Copper Zones Identified at Red Setter
announcements.insight: Wishbone Gold identifies wide gold and copper zones at Red Setter, following earlier shallow intersections. This exploration progress supports the project's potential.

announcements.headline: Unaudited Interim Results

announcements.headline: Wishbone Registers Large Telfer Area Tenement
